title: claimspec v1 — change gate
description: Claim coverage of one change. `probe` asks whether the tests defend the claims that exist; `gate` asks whether the files a change touched carry any claim at all. Measured per file against the merge-base of a reference and HEAD (or the working tree). A file is covered when a fault anchors to it, when it is a test file that defends a claim, or when an unexpired ignore entry excuses it — and every reliance on an ignore entry is listed, so a reviewer sees why the gate passed.

ref.description: The reference the change was measured against, as given (a branch, a tag, a sha).

base.description: merge-base(ref, HEAD): the commit the change is relative to.

includeDirty.description: True when the working tree was compared instead of HEAD.

strict.description: True when a non-empty change with zero evaluated files fails instead of passing with a note.

changed.description: Files changed inside the project directory, deletions excluded.

evaluated.description: covered + uncovered: the changed files that are source and not excluded.

reliedOn.description: Unexpired ignore entries that excused at least one changed file. The gate passed *because of* these; a reviewer reads them.

expired.description: Expired ignore entries that would have matched a changed file. They excuse nothing; the files are reported as uncovered.
